tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur sgrogs pa'i dge 'dun rnams la snyan du gsol ba bzhugs so// oṃ swasti/ rnam dkar byang chub sems kyis thugs rgyud gtam/ /rnam dag khrims ldan ngur smrig rgyal mtshan can/ /rnam grol phan bde'i 'byung gnas dge 'dun sde/ /rnam mang 'gro ba'i bsod nams zhing mchog rgyal/ /zhes dge legs su byed pa'i tshig sngon du brjod nas/ de yang lha dang bcas pa'i 'gro ba ma lus shing lus pa med pa'i mchod 'os dpang gyur dam pa'i yon tan rjes su bsngags pa'i bstod 'os dam par gyur pa phun sum tshogs pa'i dge 'dun 'dus pa rgya mtshor zhu gsol/ lus can kun gyi phan bde'i grib bsil dam par gyur pa bdag cag gi ston pa mnyam med shākya'i rgyal po'i lung dang rtogs pa'i sgo nas mngon par bsdus pa'i bstan pa'i snying po spyi dang bye brag tu 'khrul pa'i dri ma zad par spangs shing gangs ri'i ljongs 'dir kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i bstan pa gyen du 'degs pa la 'gran zlas dben pa rje btsun sa skya pa'i bstan pa rin po che dar zhing rgyas pa dang bstan 'dzin gyi skyes chen dam pa bdag cag la bka' drin che ba'i rtsa ba'i bla ma rnam gnyis kyis gtsor mdzad ris dang phyogs su ma mchis pa'i bla chen rdo rje 'chang dngos rnams zhabs pad brtan pa dang / rang re'i chos grwa chen po thub bstan lha chen dang gsang sngags bde chen gling gnyis gtso bor smos pa'i mtshon phyogs bcu'i dge 'dun gyi sde thams cad du'ang bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa rin po che dar zhing rgyas par bya ba'i phyir dang / nor 'dzin yangs pa'i gzhir 'khod pa'i skye 'gro rnams la bde skyid rdzogs ldan gzhon nu'i dus la spyod pa lta bu 'byung ba dang / khyad par du yang rje btsun gong ma'i ring lugs kyi rjes su zhugs pa kho bo cag spun gnyis kyang tshe mthar phyin zhing mkhas pa'i bya ba 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi sgo nas rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po cher byi dor byed pa'i mthu dang ldan pa dang bstan pa'i bya ba thos bsam sgom gsum gyi sgo nas gdul bya phal mo che smin grol thar pa'i lam la 'god pa dang /

de dag gi gnas skabs su 'dod don 'grub pa'i 'gal rkyen nyer 'tshe mtha' dag zhi zhing mthun rkyen ci bsam chos bzhin 'grub pa'i rim gro la dmigs/ nged rang mched kyi lag tu shi gson 'ga' re'i dngos po ched du sger 'bul byung ba rnams kyi steng nas zhabs tog ci 'grub kyi nyin bzhi'i ring 7rgyal gsung bka' 'gyur rin po che gsung sgrog gnang dgos la/ thog ma tshogs 'phral skyabs sems sngon 'gro'i thub dbang gi bstod pa sems brtse ma kha skong bcas dang mdzad bcu'i bstod pa/ zhi ba gdong bzhi ma/ bir bstod/ gong bstod/ sa lo/ sngags 'chang yab sras gsum/ kun bsod yab sras/ bdag cag gi rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa de nyid bcas kyi sku bstod bsdus pa re mjug tu bzang spyod kyi yan lag bdun pa bcas dang / dngos gzhi gsung sgrog la gong 'khod kyi don tshan de dag la dmigs 7rgyal gsung rin po che'i tshig don la spyan dmigs rtse gcig gi sgo nas gsung sgrog dang / ja rgyab la bsam pa myur 'grub ma/ kho bo cag ring du 'tsho ba'i smon gsol/ gung tshigs thog gsang chen ma dang dkon mchog rjes dran gyi mdo yon sbyong gi gzungs smon lam bcas/ mjug grol khar sgrol gsol sher bzlog dgu tshar 'gro la bde skyid ma bsngo smon shis brjod kyis brgyan pa bcas thugs bsam che bskyed kyi sgo nas re 'bras rnams la don smin 'byung ba'i rim gro 'gyur che smin grub zhig gnang ba zhu/ mkhyen pa nam mkha'i ngos ltar rab yangs shing / /mdo rgyud dgongs don 'byed la 'dren byed gsal/ /rnam dag khrims ldan dge 'dun 'dus pa'i sdes/ /bdag cag ci bsam 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog/ //shu bhaṃ mastu sarba dza ga taṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur sgrog pa'i dge 'dun rnams la snyan zhu/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
